extraFacts.source: Parker Pneumatic Division Europe catalogues PDE3570TCEN (P1F, 32 to 125 mm) and PDE2667TCEN (P1F-T, 160 to 320 mm)

extraFacts.fact: Parker gives the P1F maximum operating pressure as 10 bar (145 psi) and the standard operating temperature range as -20 to +80 °C.

extraFacts.fact: Theoretical push force at 6 bar (87 psi) = pi x bore^2 / 4 x 0.6 N/mm2: 32 mm bore 483 N, 40 mm bore 754 N, 50 mm bore 1178 N, 63 mm bore 1870 N, 80 mm bore 3016 N, 100 mm bore 4712 N, 160 mm bore 12064 N, 250 mm bore 29452 N, 320 mm bore 48255 N. extraFacts.source: F = P x A (basic fluid power); 6 bar = 0.6 N/mm2; 1 bar = 14.5038 psi
